derivation:
by classical
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf' (Finset.univ_nontrivial.erase_nonempty (a := a)) (fun i => x.weights i); exact ⟨i, (Finset.mem_erase.mp hi).1, by simp [hornDeformation_weights, (Finset.mem_erase.mp hi).1, hornDepth_def, ← hmin]⟩
explanation: This is a specialization of the finite-infimum attainment lemma to the non-apex indices and the simplex weights. Unfolding the deformation and horn-coordinate definitions then shows that a minimizing coordinate vanishes at time one.
